qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate degrees in Pharmacy/Life sciences/Biotechnology for Scientist; 12th pass + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + 5 years experience OR Graduate degree in Life sciences + 2 years experience OR Post graduate degree in Life sciences for Technical Support.
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): Post graduate degrees in Pharmacy/Life sciences/Biotechnology. PhD thesis submitted in Pharmacy, Life sciences, Biotechnology, or an equivalent discipline. At least 1 year of research experience in protein isolation from mammalian/bacterial samples, LC-MS-based omics studies, and characterization. Project Technical Support-III: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + Five years of experience in a medical/research laboratory OR Three-year graduate degree in the Life sciences field + Two years of experience in a medical/research laboratory OR Post graduates (PG) degree in Life sciences without professional experience. Experience in in vitro anti-TB assays, cell culture handling, and in vivo animal experiments, preferably with knowledge of handling Mycobacterium tuberculosis cultures.

selection_process: Submission of CV and cover letter via email Interview (Physical/Online mode)
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIPER Hajipur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Hajipur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIPER Hajipur recruitment is 08 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this NIPER Hajipur recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I and Project Technical Support-III in this recruitment drive by NIPER Hajipur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist-I position, candidates need to have Post graduate degrees in Pharmacy/Life sciences/Biotechnology and a submitted PhD thesis in a relevant discipline, along with research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-III position offers a salary of Rs. 28,000.00 plus 10% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NIPER Hajipur recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their CV and cover letter along with scanned copies of supporting documents via email to the specified addresses before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support at NIPER Hajipur are on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview for the selected candidates can be conducted in a physical or online mode. Candidates will be informed about the interview details via email.
